title: Have an extra battery ready
text:
Have an extra battery ready. EDIT: This baby eats batteries. I have had other food scales and they got used for months before needing a new battery. This one has gone through two in way too short amount of time. I will be looking into returning this item and hopefully a different one will be better. Outside of the fact that it eats batteries, it’s a good scale.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
I’ve had this for just under two weeks. I’ve used it probably ten times and it already needs a new battery. I’m hoping that it just got shipped with a crappy battery because other than that, I do like the scale.

If you’re planning to get this, have an extra battery ready for it. If a new battery drains just as fast, then this will definitely be updated and lose some stars.
